_comment: PLACEHOLDERS. Calibrate with: python scripts/worker/dsa_worker.py --calibrate (with the DSA chat open in the worker Chrome). For every MISS: right-click the element > Inspect, copy the outer HTML, give it to DSA and ask for one stable CSS selector, paste it here. Prefer data-testid / aria-label attributes over generated class names.
_input: the prompt text box (textarea or contenteditable)
_send: the send button (enabled once text is present)
_stop: the stop-generating button; it exists ONLY while the model is answering
_last_answer: the newest assistant message body; the LAST match is used
_copy_button: the copy button of the newest answer; the LAST match is used (keeps markdown/code fences)
_challenge: CSS markers of a login / CAPTCHA / verify-human page. Zero matches is the healthy state; calibrate does not count this as a MISS.
challenge: iframe[src*='captcha' i], iframe[src*='challenge' i], input[type='password'], #challenge-form, [id*='captcha' i]
_challenge_text: phrases (lowercase) that mean a human check when found in the page text
